verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from multiple gov.uk guidance pages (Corporation Tax, VAT registration, MTD sign-up, employer registration, the HMRC org page). That indicates the main public reading surface is plain readable HTML with no CAPTCHA or JS-only shell. However, the developer hub's robots.txt disallows all crawlers except Googlebot, so a well-behaved identified agent is shut out of HMRC's API documentation. The API host answers keyless requests with a structured header error rather than a bot wall. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming gov.uk pages return 200 to an identified non-browser user agent, and agent access to the developer-hub documentation (currently robots-blocked for non-Google agents).
